//: The application has NO dependencies: it is static ES modules with no build step, and public/ is served as-is. Nothing is declared here on purpose — a declared dependency means the deploy build runs `npm ci`, and a lockfile that resolves differently on the build machine than on the author's then fails the deploy for reasons unrelated to the app. Local tooling (wrangler, playwright, esbuild) is installed on demand with `npm run toolchain`.
